text: {"lessons":["My repeated sales of B and C at gains felt satisfying, but I should base each sale on expected return and portfolio needs, not the comfort of realizing a profit.","I held through several account declines without trading; holding can be appropriate, but I should actively reassess concentration and downside risk rather than let positions drift.","Selling D and E at steep losses was painful, while later buying B and C and selling C at a gain reinforced my tendency to treat positions separately; I should judge every holding by its future prospects, not its purchase price or realized gain or loss."]}
